comparison.objective: Raise probes while indexing a wafer stage, then restore contact without scratching; candidate tunes a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual sustained probe lift and stage indexing versus tool insertion, collar adjustment, tightening and repeated impact evaluation.
comparison.success_condition: Body reports irreversible failure from cumulative lateral probe contact and a full score after safe indexing/return, but omits a complete numeric scoring rubric and spec version. Candidate has explicit energy, velocity, stroke and repeatability criteria.
comparison.reason: Both use dynamic observation only broadly; probe-clearance coordination is different from damping calibration.
